_readme: Recall probe, candidates ruled out (2026-09-27). The additions are in companies/membership-ledger.json under recall_additions.

rejections.name: Ministry Brands
rejections.reason: control position: the firm took the lead position in October 2016, the previous lead investor Genstar keeping 'a significant minority investment'; later part of Community Brands

rejections.name: SignUp Software
rejections.reason: control position: a recommended public cash offer by the firm for the whole company, April 2023

rejections.name: Insite Software
rejections.reason: control position: 'acquired by Insight Venture Partners in 2019' (a filing's officer biography); folded into Episerver

rejections.name: Venn
rejections.reason: bought from Two Sigma in January 2026 through Solovis, a company the firm controls (D3.5)

rejections.name: Datto, ChannelAdvisor, Amber Road
rejections.reason: bought by companies the firm controlled (Kaseya, CommerceHub, E2open); the firm financed the buyers (D3.5)

rejections.name: WeWork
rejections.reason: Fund XII's 12.5M shares come from the PIPE at the BowX merger of October 2021, an instrument in the listed shell; no private round names the firm (decisions.md R8, Erik's to confirm)

rejections.name: Avenue A (aQuantive)
rejections.reason: a 1999 investors rights agreement names 'Insight Venture Associates LLC' with no fund numeral beside an individual; the firm's own list, which reaches back to 1996, does not carry the company, so the signatory's identity is not established

rejections.name: Yubo, MySocialCloud
rejections.reason: Jerry Murdock's own money and board seat, no fund of the firm named (T2)

rejections.name: Genesis Partners IV portfolio
rejections.reason: in 2019 the firm bought most of another fund's portfolio in one secondary transaction; the companies are not named in any source read and none is added on that basis

rejections.name: Bill.com, CoreWeave, Rubrik, Nordstrom, GSI Commerce, IREN, Zeta Global, Nebius, ServiceNow, Nasdaq, Oracle, Ariba, Q2, nCino
rejections.reason: sale consideration: stock received when these companies bought a company the firm had backed (Divvy, Weights & Biases, Laminar, HauteLook, Fanatics, Mirantis, Marigold's enterprise business, Tavily, Armis, eVestment, Primavera, Procuri, PrecisionLender, SimpleNexus), each of which has its own row

rejections.name: 60 issuers held only through Insight Partners Public Equities
rejections.reason: public-market purchases reported on Form 13F with no venture entry (D2, T3)
